page.overview:
What is Battle of Corulag?

The Battle of Corulag was fought between the Fel Empire and the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances during the Sith–Imperial War. Oron Jaeger, an Imperial Army General of the 501st Legion received a head injury during the battle, requiring him to undergo cyborg augmentation.
